status_definitions.implemented: Production-path behavior exists with tests and no synthetic success fallback.
status_definitions.experimental: Executable prototype exists, but security, validity, or operations evidence is incomplete.
status_definitions.adapter_required: The domain contract exists but requires an approved provider or AXIOM adapter.
status_definitions.specified: The behavior is designed but not yet implemented.
status_definitions.disabled: The capability must not be represented as available in governed or release builds.

capabilities.summary: Flutter and Riverpod curriculum overview and detail screens read the bundled SQLite curriculum database.
Ontario Grades 9-12 curriculum records are available in JSON and SQLite, but complete source provenance, licensing, review status, and reproducible-build evidence are not yet enforced.
Versioned curriculum packs will bind jurisdiction, authority, source digest, parser version, licence, review state, content digest, and supersession metadata.
Governed learner-data and provider effects will be submitted through the AXIOM Gateway and follow Gateway to Hypervisor to Sandbox to Grid.
The existing Phi-3 binding is a prototype and must not report simulated logits output as a tutor response. A configured provider must fail closed when unavailable.
Deterministic mathematics and science verification will run through a signed scientific-tool provider capsule.
Bounded image decoding and TFLite scaffolding exist, but the current classifier is not a validated handwritten-math parser.
The raw UDP/TCP classroom mesh is development-only until authenticated encryption, identity, replay, authorization, conflict, and operational controls are evidenced.
Classroom synchronization will use admitted education nodes and AXIOM signed causal bundles rather than an application-owned authority path.
The current Hive student_data box is not an evidenced encrypted learner-record store and must not support governed learner data.
Learner events, preferences, accommodations, and progress will be encrypted, purpose-bound, revocable, selectively exportable, and human-appealable.
Existing mock IRT fields are heuristics and are not psychometrically calibrated item-response parameters.
Learners will be able to export selected work, progress evidence, consent records, and provenance without unrelated private records.
Education credentials require the approved AXIOM SSI credential profile, issuer governance, revocation, and verification evidence.
Keyboard, screen-reader, contrast, text scaling, reduced-motion, stylus alternatives, and accessible export requirements are release gates.

non_claims: No current model binding provides a complete local tutor.
The current classroom mesh is not an AXIOM federation or secure production transport.
Local-first architecture alone does not establish legal or regulatory compliance.
Mock difficulty and IRT values are not validated psychometrics.
Installing an education capsule does not grant access to learner data.
